prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-detailed close-up bedroom selfie using an approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with preserved face, fair warm skin and realistic pores, shoulder-length straight chocolate-brown bob, defined brows, curled lashes, coral glossy lips, and a relaxed confident closed-mouth smile, wearing an opaque black velvet or plush high-neck top.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up reclined selfie on bed or pillow, head slightly tilted toward camera, shoulders relaxed, neck and face primary focus, teal-blue curtains, neutral bedding, warm ring light and phone flash.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong directional ring light with phone flash creates realistic catchlights and soft dramatic illumination, cozy modern private bedroom without sensual invitation.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, sharp skin pores, hair and eyes, realistic velvet texture, subtle depth and natural color, no airbrushing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved-adult facial identity from the required reference without altering facial structure. Create a hyper-detailed close-up bedroom selfie of a woman with fair warm skin and realistic pores, shoulder-length straight chocolate-brown blunt bob with face-framing layers, defined brows, long curled lashes, coral-red glossy lips, and a relaxed confident closed-mouth smile. She wears an opaque black velvet or plush high-neck top and reclines comfortably on a bed or pillow with her head slightly tilted toward camera. Include teal-blue curtains, neutral bedding, warm ring light and phone flash. Keep the face, eyes, skin texture and hair primary, with realistic catchlights, subtle depth, natural color and detailed fabric.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low-cut top, exposed collarbone/chest emphasis, seductive pout, sensual invitation, lingerie, nudity, altered face, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult face reference. Preserve facial identity, hair, skin texture, expression, lighting, and bedroom; wardrobe may be replaced with an equally opaque high-neck alternative. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Replaced low-cut top, exposed-chest emphasis, seductive pout and sensual-invitation wording with opaque high-neck coverage and a neutral confident smile.
